checks: steps_continuous (step k start == step k-1 target)
every_step_within_its_certified_box (trajectory start/target == step ticks; every goal inside that step's start..target box)
1_waypoints_and_range_within_the_approve.not_added: no absolute distance / angle cap: the candidate's targets are computed at runtime from current geometry, so START cannot pre-bind a magnitude from verified evidence; a session that needs a magnitude bound uses the existing manual approval

checks: planned_from_current_actual (first step start == the raw the plan used)
fresh_actual_matches_plan_start (a new read right before use, right arm, rounded ticks)
2_plan_actual_vs_fresh_actual.existing_contract_after_approval: sweepick_move_a still rebuilds the trajectory from the read just before the first write and re-certifies a changed start (unchanged)

fallback: any failed check -> observation_move_preapproval_not_applicable + existing operator decision; no automatic move
